items.title: Larry Ellison Scraps Plan to Sell Up to $7.5 Billion Worth of Oracle Stock
items.summary: Larry Ellison  scrapped plans to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of his  Oracle  stake, a day after the company disclosed the billionaire’s trading plans.  In a statement Saturday, Oracle said Ellison had reversed course.  “No Oracle stock was sold under that plan, and he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock,” it said.

items.title: Anthropic’s Prisoner’s Dilemma: Dario Amodei Hits the Brakes on AI While Begging Everyone Else to Do the Same

items.title: Why Power Integrations (POWI) Stock Is Trading Up Today
